footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: includes $636K from other items after tax.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Jan 25, 2026 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 15.5% to $1.0B in fiscal 2026 (ended Jan 25, 2026). Gross margin was 50.8%, versus 49.2% a year earlier, and operating income fell 34.8% to $32.6M, a 3.1% margin.
The net loss narrowed to $40.4M, or −$0.46 per share, from $162M. Operating cash flow was $181M and free cash flow $171M, versus $50.1M.
sources: Semtech Corporation Form 10-K for FY2026 (SEC EDGAR)

revenueLine.say: Product made up 90 percent of revenue.
